question: What is the problem with this code?
options: There is no problem; this is correct, safe code
malloc() was called with the wrong size
After free(p), p becomes a dangling pointer, and dereferencing it (*p) is undefined behavior
free() should have been called before assigning *p = 42
explanation: free(p) releases the memory back to the system, but p still holds that now-invalid address — a dangling pointer. Dereferencing it afterward is undefined behavior, even though it may sometimes appear to 'work'.
